title: Voertex_pvp
description: ⚡ Vortex PvP is a competitive Minecraft PvP resource pack featuring custom swords, crystals, items, and a clean PvP-focused style. Made for smooth gameplay and a unique battlefield experience. ⚔️
body:
⚡ Vortex PvP ⚡

A custom Minecraft PvP resource pack made for competitive players who want a clean and powerful PvP experience.

Features:
⚔️ Custom PvP weapons and items
💎 Unique crystal textures
🗡️ Custom sword designs
🛡️ PvP-focused visuals
✨ Clean and smooth style for fights

Made for Minecraft 1.21.1 PvP.
More updates and improvements coming soon!

Enjoy the battle. ⚡
